titulo: Consumer Surplus: Getting More Than You Paid For
subtitulo: People are willing to pay more than what companies charge

contenido.speaker: Naval
frases: Consumer surplus and producer surplus are important concepts.
Consumer surplus is the excess value you get from something when you pay less than you were willing to pay.
I get a lot of joy out of my morning Starbucks coffee.
So if my coffee cost $20, I would pay it.
They can’t price the coffee at $20 just for me, because they’re selling the exact same product to others.
So I’m getting a lot of consumer surplus out of the coffee.
Consumer surplus is the extra value you get when you pay less than you were willing All businesses generate consumer surplus.
It’s a good thing to keep in mind when someone’s harping on about how evil companies are.
Amazon might be a trillion-dollar company, but I’ll bet they’re generating trillions of dollars in consumer surplus through people’s willingness to pay for convenience.
A lot of people are willing to pay more than what Amazon charges.
